usage_rules.headings: Use Playfair Display for H1-H3. Track tight (-0.02em). Weight: SemiBold (600) or Black (900).
usage_rules.body: Use Inter for all UI text. Relaxed line-height (1.6).
usage_rules.data: Use JetBrains Mono for OCR results, risk scores, and coordinates. text-xs or text-sm.

primary.description: Slate 900 - Deep Navy for Authority and Navigation

accent.description: Sky 500 - AI/Tech highlights, Links, Active States

risk.description: Standard traffic light system for Risk Reports

visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp 1px borders. No rounded corners greater than 4px. Mimic 'Legal Documents'.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards (Paper lift), shadow-xl for modals (Floating document).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on backgrounds to simulate high-quality paper.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only on sticky headers. backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/50.

rules: Use massive whitespace (py-24 or py-32) between sections.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-sm px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-sm px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all

cards.base: bg-card text-card-foreground border border-border shadow-sm rounded-sm p-6

inputs.base: flex h-10 w-full rounded-sm border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

badges.risk_high: bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-200 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono rounded-sm
badges.risk_medium: bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono rounded-sm
badges.risk_low: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono rounded-sm

motion.loading: Skeleton loaders (shimmer) for data fetching. Spinner for actions.

images.description: Modern skyscraper against a clear blue sky - Use for Hero Section Background with overlay
Lawyers discussing legal documents - Use for 'Why Choose Us' or 'Legal Verification' section
Aerial view of city with tall buildings - Use for Dashboard placeholder or Location features
Lawyer examining documents - Use for 'How it Works' section

do_not: Do NOT use gradients for text.
Do NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it sharp (rounded-sm or rounded-md).
Do NOT use generic 'Lorem Ipsum'. Use realistic legal placeholder text.
Do NOT center align dashboard data widgets.
must_do: MUST support Dark/Light mode toggle, but optimize for Light mode (Trust).
MUST add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.
MUST use standard Shadcn component names but customize styling via Tailwind classes.

tech_stack_instructions.charts: Use 'recharts' (via Shadcn Charts) for Risk Scores and Timelines.
tech_stack_instructions.tables: Use '@tanstack/react-table' (via Shadcn Data Table) for Title Chains.
